brief: The canvas presents a confined, dome-shaped world—the interior of a snow globe. Vibrant curtains of pulsating, ethereal light, rendered in shades of emerald, sapphire, and violet, swirl and undulate across the space, depicting the northern lights. Overlaid upon this shifting glow is a constant flurry of white particles, which drift down, accumulate at the base, and catch the light. The entire composition maintains a perpetual, swirling motion of colored gases and falling snow, creating a rich sense of contained depth and continuous organic change.
